core_obligations: Keep K3-type regularized action hypotheses, terminal GQ-Fano definition and cyclic kernel construction.
Keep quotient Y=X/K and proof that all divisorial ramification is exactly S.
Keep H-Q-factoriality and canonical Fano proof, including eliminating torsion of K_Y+D by adjunction, Kawamata–Viehweg vanishing and Serre duality.
Keep cyclic-cover m-divisibility on the smooth locus and extension to Cl(Y); only then bound m by canonical Fano Weil index.
proof_roadmap: Establish cyclicity from faithful tangent action at a fixed divisor.
Identify divisorial ramification and form the quotient by the pointwise kernel.
Prove canonical Fano and actual linear divisibility after eliminating torsion.
Apply the external maximal Weil-index bound.
difficulty_reason: The final three-line proof is not the difficulty-bearing unit. The retained current core constructs the cyclic quotient, excludes other divisorial ramification, relates equivariant class groups, upgrades torsion K_Y+D to actual linear triviality through an adjunction exact sequence and vanishing/duality contradiction, and then combines canonical-discrepancy control with cyclic-cover divisibility in Cl(Y). This connected quotient/index argument is nonroutine beyond ordinary qualifying-exam material. Lemma 2.8, Corollary 2.9 and section 11 support are one proof chain, not extra counts.
difficulty_assessment_limits: H2 supported by the retained construction and torsion/divisibility bridge; H3 not asserted. External boundedness and cyclic-cover theorems remain allowed standard tools. No independent correctness certification.
